items.briefing:
Google has warned that AI is actively changing how cyber attacks are carried out, making threats faster and harder to detect. This comes as a separate incident showed an AI agent breaching a Spanish organisation and altering personal data — a sign that AI-enabled attacks are no longer theoretical. Closer to home, a major bank has moved to block staff from sharing confidential data with public AI tools, a reminder that everyday AI use carries real privacy risks.

A Cisco zero-day vulnerability has also been flagged involving authentication weaknesses in API systems — worth raising with your IT team if your organisation uses Cisco products. **Practical tip:** Avoid entering work-related or confidential information into public AI chatbots like ChatGPT — use only approved internal tools.

featured.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
featured.summary: The authentication bypass flaw CVE-2026-76460 impacts Cisco's Identity Services Engine (ISE) and received a maximum 10 out of 10 CVSS score.
